comments.value: No wonder X still has both Twitter and X icons. It's already X, so it should be unified with X...

Related:

Custom URL icon for profile.

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/custom-url-icon-for-profile

“However, this cannot detect the service if the service is one for which the domain is not uniquely determined, such as Misskey and Mastodon.”

All accounts created on bluesky service can be accessed using https://bsky.app/profile/<profilename>, including custom domain handles.

So binding the icon to bsky.app should be the way to go. This ofc. can't account for custom instances.
@{629fc21f2b0c690b785dab7f|full_name} All accounts created at any instance can be accessed at that link, as long as they publish a Bluesky profile (which every account on the network currently does).

I expect most Bluesky links will be to a profile, but maybe someone wants to link a starter pack or feed. Those could use a modified icon to indicate the type, but they should at least be marked as Bluesky as well.

@{629fc21f2b0c690b785dab7f|full_name} I would just add, It would be ideal if it checked the input URL's destination first, so that people who use vanity URL usernames fully can still have the icon. Mine for example https://bsky.invertex.xyz is still a BlueSky link.

This is a more ideal way to link your BSKY account and/or its content! Because if we ever needed to migrate to some other service, you can just update your server redirect. I can link my content like https://bsky.invertex.xyz/post/3lbltee7tz62n and it just works.

details:
Currently Bluesky doesn't have an icon for links.

It has an icon - a butterfly - and appears to now be the offramp for Twitter. VRChat have an official account there!

Please add an icon for Bluesky.
